summary: U.S. equities traded mixed on Monday as geopolitical risk and tariff threats overshadowed last week's gains. The S&P 500 slipped 0.2% while the Nasdaq fell 0.4%, weighed down by semiconductor weakness, though the Dow edged up 0.2% on blue-chip strength. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is expected to unveil new Iran sanctions later today after President Trump threatened the country with economic retaliation, while failed U.S.-Canada trade talks have raised reciprocal tariff concerns. Investors are looking ahead to Nvidia's Wednesday earnings and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole speech on Friday, both of which could determine near-term market direction. Meanwhile, crypto markets extended their breakout from last week, with Bitcoin pushing toward $80,000 on record ETF inflows and Ethereum rallying alongside. Treasury yields remain near multi-year highs, keeping pressure on risk assets as markets await clarity from the Fed on its inflation assessment and rate trajectory.

signals.title: U.S.-Iran sanctions and Canada tariff threats escalate geopolitical risk
signals.desc: Treasury Secretary Bessent set to announce Iran sanctions and U.S.-Canada trade talks collapsed, raising tariff fears and pressuring risk sentiment.

signals.title: Semiconductor stocks drag Nasdaq lower ahead of Nvidia earnings
signals.desc: Chip stocks fell sharply with the iShares Semiconductor ETF down nearly 3%, reflecting earnings anxiety before Nvidia's Wednesday report.

signals.title: Fed Chair Warsh to speak at Jackson Hole on Friday
signals.desc: Markets await Warsh's keynote for clues on inflation assessment and policy direction, with limited conventional forward guidance expected.

signals.title: Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs post record weekly inflows
signals.desc: Spot Bitcoin ETFs pulled in $1.92 billion and Ethereum ETFs added $697 million last week, confirming institutional demand and pushing BTC toward $80,000.

signals.title: 10-year Treasury yield near 20-month high at 4.74%
signals.desc: Rising bond yields driven by oil-price inflation fears keep borrowing costs elevated, pressuring equity valuations and risk appetite.

verdict: Markets face a critical week with Nvidia earnings, Jackson Hole, and geopolitical uncertainty likely to drive high volatility and sector rotation.
